thread.title: Maxim Group downgrades Apple on subscription concerns - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Maxim Group downgrades Apple on subscription concerns - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Maxim Group downgrades Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) from Buy to Hold and lowers the price target from $204 to $200, a 6% upside to yesterday’s close.
Analyst Nehal Chokshi cites concerns about the services business and subscriptions: “We believe at best AAPL’s subscription businesses at maturity will generate an operating margin in-line with the current corporate average of ~25% with some risk that actual long-term OM [operating margin] will be lower.”
Apple shares are down 0.13% premarket to $187.65.
 Apple: Bears Were Wrong (Again) »
